article_title: Bylaw 14776 — Dominion Bridge Company Limited Aid Bylaw 1929, Repeal Bylaw 2025
body:
Bylaw No. 14776 
Page 1 
CITY OF BURNABY 
BYLAW NO. 14776 
A BYLAW to repeal 
Dominion Bridge Company 
Limited Aid By-Law 1929 
The Council of the City of Burnaby ENACTS as follows: 
1.
This Bylaw may be cited as DOMINION BRIDGE COMPANY LIMITED AID
BY-LAW 1929, REPEAL BYLAW 2025.
2.
Bylaw No. 937, being Dominion Bridge Company Limited Aid By-Law 1929, and
all subsequent amendments are hereby repealed.
Read a first time this 28th day of October, 2025 
Read a second time this 28th day of October, 2025 
Read a third time 28th day of October, 2025 
Reconsidered and adopted this 15th day of November, 2025 
MAYOR 
DEPUTY CORPORATE OFFICER 
Signed original bylaw on file.

minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby repeals 1929 Dominion Bridge aid bylaw
minutes_briefs.summary: The City of Burnaby has officially repealed a 1929 bylaw that provided financial aid to the Dominion Bridge Company. This old law, and all its amendments, is no longer in effect. The repeal was adopted by Council on November 15, 2025, and removes an outdated piece of legislation that no longer applies to any current business or activity.
